description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema, which manages configuration directives and their defaults for the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for schema serialization, instance retrieval, defining directives, and setting value constraints.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema
classes.description: A class responsible for defining, serializing, and retrieving configuration directives and their associated defaults for the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: makeFromSerial
methods.description: Unserializes and returns an instance of HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema from a schema serialized file.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves or sets the singleton instance of the configuration schema.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Defines a new configuration directive with its default value, type, and null allowance.

methods.name: addValueAliases
methods.description: Defines alias values for a specific directive.

methods.name: addAllowedValues
methods.description: Sets the set of allowed values for a directive.

methods.name: addAlias
methods.description: Creates an alias for an existing directive.

methods.name: postProcess
methods.description: Simplifies the info array by replacing stdClass objects with type integers where appropriate.
